name: Range day at Ustka: P-15 targets in from the sea, a two-missile salvo at each
description: A live-fire range shoot in the style of the Polish range at Ustka on the Baltic coast (roadmap 10.1): the vehicle stands deployed on the shore, and two targets made from P-15 anti-ship missiles come in from the sea one after the other, fast and low. The range's orders are a salvo of two missiles at each target: the second goes as soon as the launcher allows, before the first has reached it. The NPC commander runs the crew; take any seat, or his.
notes: The range and the target type follow docs/research/OSA_RESEARCH_2026-10.md section 9 (samsim_thread, ilya_prosto: Osa shoots at Ustka; SAM Simulator has an Osa double kill against a P-15 target there). The two-missile salvo, 3-5 s apart: korovin_tiv_2010; two missiles selected at ВНИМАНИЕ: flak11. PLACEHOLDERS: the targets' speed (kept within the head-on zone's 300 m/s band), heights, courses and echo, the gap between them, the shore's height. The sea is flat ground: no sea clutter.

terrain.notes: The beach and the sea north of it, both flat.
